author: kingpanther13
releaseNotes:
v4.1.0 - 2026-09-03
- build(deps): bump actions/setup-java from 5 to 6 in the github-actions group ([#394](https://github.com/kingpanther13/Hubitat-local-MCP-server/pull/394), @app/dependabot)
- build(deps): bump the gradle-dependencies group with 3 updates ([#396](https://github.com/kingpanther13/Hubitat-local-MCP-server/pull/396), @app/dependabot)
- fix: correct rule-health structural detection, restore three tools broken on platform 2.5.1.174 and in-place restore of rules with device pickers (#395)
  - Rule health no longer reports a missing END-IF on rules whose IF/ELSE/END-IF blocks were built in the Rule Machine UI, or on rules carrying leftover settings from earlier edits.
  - Rule health responses gain `orphanedActionRows`, listing settings rows left behind by an interrupted write or a removed action. Diagnostic only.
  - `removeAction` now refuses to delete an ELSE / ELSE-IF / END-IF row when that would unbalance the rule, and refuses any structural row while the rule's compiled action order cannot be read. `moveAction` and `modifyAction` refuse there too. `clearActions` also clears leftover rows that were never part of the compiled action list.
  - Editing a **disabled** rule or app is now refused with an explanation and the remedy (re-enable, edit, re-disable). Previously some edits reported success having changed nothing.
  - Fixed `hub_search_tools` failing with a security error when the platform rejects a computed subscript key.
  - Fixed `hub_list_devices(scope='all')` and `hub_update_mcp_settings` device validation failing on hub platform 2.5.1.173 and later, which no longer serve the endpoint they used.
  - Fixed Visual Rules Builder rules created on hubs with VRB 2.0 (platform 2.5.1.138 and later) being written in a shape the hub rejects, backups of Visual Rules being restored as Rule Machine rules, and rename, pause **and resume** reporting failure on writes that succeeded.
  - Fixed `hub_restore_backup` failing with "applied partially" (hub 500) on any Rule Machine rule that has a device picker. A restore that could not replay a saved setting now reports it instead of omitting it silently.
  - Visual Rule responses carry the rule's own name; the hub's "(Paused)" decoration is no longer echoed into a save or reported as the name (`rawName` carries the hub's form).
  - A `comment` action without `text` is refused instead of leaving a row Rule Machine never bakes.
  - `hub_search_tools` no longer keeps its ~244 KB index in app state; every tool call was paying to re-serialise it.
  - Cloud-relay self-budgeting (`relayBudgetMs`) now defaults to 6000 ms (was 8000), leaving real headroom under the relay's timeout. An explicit setting is unaffected.
